questions.q: When and where is the tournament?
questions.a: The 11th Penn Invitational is on Saturday, February 13, 2027, on the University of Pennsylvania campus in Philadelphia.
The Penn Invitational is a Division C (high school) tournament. Schools can register up to two teams.
$250 per team. The fee is waived for Philadelphia school district high schools.
For 2027, registration opened September 23 for Pennsylvania teams and September 26 for everyone else, and closed October 9.
Every competitor needs a signed liability waiver and a signed photo release, turned in before the tournament starts. Both are linked in the Forms section above.
Events follow the official Science Olympiad rules for the season. Anything specific to our tournament is in the information document and posted under Updates.

questions.q: Do coaches have to run an event?
questions.a: No. Every event is written and run by Penn students who competed in Science Olympiad, so coaches are free to watch their teams.

questions.q: Where do scheduling and scoring happen?
questions.a: On Scilympiad. Registered teams get details by email.

questions.q: When do results and tests come out?
questions.a: Results are posted after awards. Tests and keys from recent years are linked on the Past Tournaments page.

questions.q: Who do I contact with questions?
questions.a: Email pennscienceolympiad@gmail.com and a board member will reply.
